canvas.label: Interactive knowledge graph
canvas.description: Graph view. Drag to pan, use the wheel or buttons to zoom in and out, press a node to see its details and use the arrow keys to move without a mouse.
canvas.keyboardHelp: Keyboard: arrow keys to pan, + and − to zoom in and out, 0 to fit and Escape to reset.
canvas.hoverNode: Node under the pointer: {label}, type {type}, {degree} relationships.
canvas.truncatedHint: Drawing is limited to {max} nodes. Narrow it down with the filters above or export the JSON to see the full loaded subgraph: the dump bypasses the drawing cut-off.

isolatedOn.one: Showing the selected node and its only neighbor; the rest are dimmed.
isolatedOn.other: Showing the selected node and its {count} neighbors; the rest are dimmed.

canvas.noNodesInScene: There are no nodes to draw.
canvas.degradedEmpty: The graph is empty: there are no active nodes in the backend.
canvas.degradedEmptyHint: Press "Sync graph" to create the deterministic nodes and relationships.

search.label: Search for a node by name
search.hint: Choosing a node centers it and puts it in the URL, so the link can be shared.

detail.title: Node detail
detail.empty: Select a node in the graph to see what the backend knows about it.
detail.noNeighbors: This node has no relationships in the visible subgraph.
detail.scopeLink: Open this node’s full neighborhood on the server
detail.unknownNode: Node #{id} is not in the loaded subgraph.
detail.shareLinkFailed: The link could not be copied: select it below and copy it by hand.

listing.title: Graph nodes in text
listing.description: The same information as the drawing, in text: works for screen readers, as a fallback if the canvas fails to load, and as indexable content.
listing.empty: There are no nodes to list.
listing.caption: Table of graph nodes: label, type and number of relationships of each node.

page.metadataDescription: Deterministic links between authors, principles, companies, KPIs, risks, decisions, lessons and concepts, with their provenance.
page.description: Traceable links between authors, principles, companies and decisions.
page.showing: Showing {shown} of {total} nodes with these filters. Most connected first; only relationships between included nodes are shown.
page.edgesCaption: Knowledge graph relationships: source node, relationship type, target node, confidence and provenance
page.noEdges: No relationship matches the current scope.
page.truncated: Showing 30 of {total} relationships: filter to narrow the scope.
